description: A beneficial owner is anyone holding 25 percent or more of the applicant
Ownership through intermediate companies is multiplied along the chain: 70 percent of a holding company that owns 45 percent of the applicant is 31.5 percent effective
Every declared owner at or above the threshold must be verified before the case can be decided
The register does not corroborate the declared beneficial ownership; non-blocking but flagged for enhanced due diligence at the risk step
A declared owner does not appear on the register or vice versa; non-blocking finding carried to the risk step
Declared ownership percentages that do not add up to a whole are a finding for the analyst to resolve
An owner below the threshold does not have to be verified and is recorded only
